# trello-mcp

> A local Trello MCP server in Go. Stdio transport, compact curated responses, workspace allowlists and a read-only opt-in. Not the official Atlassian connector.

This file is an entrypoint index. The linked documents are the references.

- [Setup, one fetch for agents](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/avhn/trello-mcp/main/docs/setup.md): install, register with seven clients, verify, update, roll back, uninstall.
- [Tools](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/avhn/trello-mcp/main/docs/tools.md): tool behavior, parameters and synthetic examples.
- [Configuration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/avhn/trello-mcp/main/docs/configuration.md): variables, credential precedence, permissions, troubleshooting, security model.

Humans run the installer's printed absolute-path auth command themselves in a private terminal; Claude Desktop extension users enter the key and token in extension settings instead. Agents must never capture authentication output or request keys, tokens or authorization links.

Claude Desktop bundles support macOS and Windows amd64 and ship on normal releases; Linux Desktop remains beta. Verify release checksums and install/update manually. Health reports local presence/source, not validated authentication: use metadata for version, policy for restrictions, then workspace_find {} for an actual Trello read. Desktop users need no CLI auth/status. Windows refuses local path uploads and attachment downloads even with directories configured.
